prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Redesigning the sign_in page for clarity and account sync status was helpful (+8.0% win) and accurately predicted.
Adding an interactive pet preview flow on the adoption page was helpful (+8.0% win), though predictions (+10.0%) were slightly too high.
Reordering steps on the choose_path page hurt performance (-4.8%), and predictions (+5.0%) were far too high.
Finish page modifications (redesigns, hints) showed no clear effect, and predictions were consistently too high.
Adding tips carousels or waiting flows on the home page showed no clear effect, and predictions were too high.
Layout changes on the choose_path page showed no clear effect (+1.5%), and predictions (+5.0%) were too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +8.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +1.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -4.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -3.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -2.1% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: +8.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split View Pet Customization Workshop: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a side-by-side interactive workshop where selecting features immediately animates the pet model on screen. (why: Adoption conversion is low (64.5%) with a long median duration of 89s, and support emails report users being unhappy with how custom pet results look.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Quality Diagnostic Flow: Inserts a photo validation stage during custom pet photo upload that checks contrast and lighting before generation begins. (why: Support emails report custom pet generation failing or looking wrong (3 emails), leading to wasted user waiting time and abandoned adoption.)
2: [home, wait_info] Real Time Pet Render Progress Indicator: Replaces static waiting with a step-by-step progress indicator showing pet mesh assembly, animation loading, and desktop overlay setup. (why: The waiting screen has a huge mean duration (2336s) and 81.3% conversion, suggesting users think the desktop render engine has hung.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Launch System Tray Notification Prompt: Enables an automatic system tray notification trigger when pet background rendering completes. (why: Support receives emails (3) reporting that pets do not show on the desktop or users cannot tell if the app opened when rendering finishes.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Control Shortcut Quick Reference: Adds key desktop interaction shortcut hints and a tip carousel trigger to the home introduction screen. (why: Users completing onboarding often message support (3 emails) asking how to hide, summon, or talk to their companion on desktop.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Full Bleed Story Narrative Intro: Switches the story screen layout to full bleed, highlighting the desktop companion concept visually before path selection. (why: The initial story screen sets expectations; full bleed visual presentation anchors the app concept clearly before choice points.)

scores.note: High dropoff at adoption backed by support complaints; adoption redesigns previously saw strong +8.0% lift.
Direct support issues at adoption step; introducing interactive validation flows in adoption previously yielded +8.0% lift.
Home wait info changes previously underperformed with a -2.1% loss.
Addresses explicit support issues via system notifications with low config cost.
Finish hint changes historically failed to show positive lift (-3.0%).
Layout adjustments on choose_path showed negligible effects (+1.5%) in prior experiments.
